thread:
Ana: quick handoff from my shift, posting the short ops recap + next steps. root msg at 02:40 UTC

Ana: what happened — between ~02:05-02:45 UTC we saw a spike in 5xxs for the embeddings path in eu-west and token p95 regressions. Symptoms: ~503 errors for a small subset of requests and backend p95 up ~2.1x.

incident-bot: PagerDuty INC-8472 triggered @ 02:08 UTC — severity P2. Assigned: Ana (primary), Ravi (secondary).

Ravi: saw pager, jumped in. Summary of actions I took: scaled embeddings pool x2 (02:12), applied temporary routing rule to offload heavy requests to eu-central fallback (02:14).

Ana: I rolled back the recent cache config rollout (rev 2026-03-14-2024) at 02:16 after seeing correlated evictions. Also disabled the new prefix-caching optimization for embeddings. Result: 503 drop started immediately; p95 trended back to baseline by 02:38. CS notified at 02:30 about a small customer impact window.

Connor: pulled logs:
```
2026-03-15T02:10:12Z ERROR kvmgr eviction: shard=12 backlog=4096 ops/sec
2026-03-15T02:11:03Z WARN autoscaler: scale_down loop flapping, cooldown not applied properly
2026-03-15T02:12:05Z INFO embeddings-pool: scale_up requested -> allocated 4 gpus
```

Sasha: I added a short-lived route rule for large payloads (>10k tokens) to go to eu-central fallback at 02:14; we saw no timeouts on fallback and it reduced load on eu-west leader nodes for ~3m.

Ana: Current state: eu-west embeddings nominal, no active alerts. Monitoring: keeping close eye on 503 rate and p95. Temporary mitigations live: conservative autoscaler cooldown (10m) and eviction threshold bumped +10%.

Ana: Customer impact: minimal overall. A small subset of customers (~0.2% of requests in eu-west) saw 1-3 failed calls between 02:08-02:16; retries succeeded. CS has ticket ZD-9123 to follow up.

Ana: Next steps / handoff actions for night team (Ravi primary -> Connor secondary):
- keep autoscaler cooldown enforced until 03:10 UTC
- watch eu-west embeddings 503 rate; if >0.2% for 5m, run runbook "kv-eviction-threshold"
- do NOT re-roll the cache leader config or prefix-caching optimization until gating tests added
- open follow-up ticket to add deploy gating + automated eviction sim tests (label: infra/evictions)
- CS note: confirm ZD-9123 and attach timeline

Ravi: ack. I'll check metrics at ~02:50 and 03:05 and will escalate to SRE if any regression. I'll also keep the routing rule until tonight's quiet window ends.

incident-bot: INC-8472 resolved @ 02:38 UTC — resolution: rollback + scale-up. Severity downgraded to P3.

Ana: runbook links: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-eviction-threshold and https://redwood.internal/playbooks/embeddings-fallback (please review before taking action)

Connor: left diagnostics commands in #eng-ops gist (use with care):
```
kubectl -n embeddings logs -l app=kvmgr --tail=200
python tools/evictracer.py --since 5m --shard 12
```

Sasha: CS update queued. Zendesk ZD-9123 will include short blurb + timeframe.

Ana: rotation snapshot: Ana (primary) until 08:00 UTC, Ravi (secondary), Connor (overnight backup). Coverage note: SRE night team has reduced headcount 03:00-04:00 UTC — recommend Connor check at 03:10 to confirm no residual flapping.

Ravi: +1. I'll be around until 04:30 UTC if anyone needs a hand.

Ana: If you need to re-open: /incident open INC-8472 and ping #incidents.

Connor: :thumbsup:

Ana: tl;dr — rollback fixed the root trigger, scale-up mitigated capacity, monitor eu-west embeddings closely for 30m, followups: deploy gating + eviction tests + CS note. End handoff.
